name: LEBREW TEMP Thermometer
author: SongPaul
description: Reads the LEBREW TEMP (Brewmaster) BLE thermometer as a temperature sensor, so steaming can record milk temperature and stop at a target.

offset.label: Surface-to-core offset (°C)
offset.description: Added to every reading. The thermometer reads the surface of the milk with an infrared sensor, which runs cooler than the milk inside. Positive values raise the reading. Range -20 to 20.
